highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews Skia m158 alongside HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and expanded named script coverage.
highlights_body: The cumulative line includes GPU rendering corrections and a stronger per-process hash seed. Preview 1 retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0; Preview 2 introduces HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and 30 additional Script constants. Later collected work remains separate from those exact shipment summaries.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 158 without changing SkiaSharp's managed API surface. The initial cut uses HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.300 with native HarfBuzz 14.4.0; the subsequent HarfBuzz update adopts native 15.0.0.

HarfBuzzSharp adds 30 documented Script fields, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, plus 27 previously omitted constants. Existing fields, numeric values, parsing, conversions and horizontal-direction lookup remain intact; Script stays a struct rather than becoming an enum.

bullets.lead: Correct reflected hairlines and text-atlas selection
bullets.detail: Zero-length square-capped hairlines retain the correct scale under reflected transforms, with non-finite outsets suppressed. Ganesh rounds ordinary and LCD text-atlas indices before selecting a sampler to avoid interpolation errors choosing the wrong atlas.
Render-pass capacity checks account for clips still needing recording. A draw whose full effective clip stack cannot fit a fresh pass is rejected and logged rather than overflowing pass structures.

Affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 up to, but excluding, 56 get a targeted 1 ms device-loss cleanup delay. Native synchronous submission propagates fence-wait failure, but GRContext.Submit remains void. Displacement offsets use float precision to match filter bounds.

The HashCode polyfill shared by SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now seeds from RandomNumberGenerator instead of System.Random. Hash codes remain randomized between processes and stable within a process; first use adds cryptography initialization overhead.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Replaced the shared HashCode polyfill's seed with OS-generated randomness and enabled analyzer checks for insecure randomness in shipped code.

preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5: Preview 2 introduces HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and 30 additional named Script constants. GPU fixes address reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, Graphite clip capacity and affected ARM Vulkan device-loss cleanup.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2: Preview 1 introduces Skia m158 without changing the SkiaSharp managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates bundled HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants while preserving the existing struct-based API, parsing and conversions. Removing the unused deprecated font-face setter import does not remove a public managed member; the assembly version remains 1.0.0.0.

v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m158.
v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.body: The managed API surface is unchanged. HarfBuzzSharp packages move to revision 14.4.0.300 while the bundled HarfBuzz engine stays at 14.4.0.

v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.headline: Preview 2 adds HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and GPU correctness fixes.
v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.body: HarfBuzzSharp gains 30 named Script constants. Rendering corrections cover reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, with a targeted Vulkan device-loss cleanup workaround for affected ARM drivers.
